results.query: What are the standard letter suffixes used to designate manual, mechanized, automatic, and robotic application modes for welding processes?
results.answer: In Table A4—Suffixes for Application Mode of Welding, Joining, and Allied Processes (printed p. 74), six standard suffix letter modifiers are defined: -AD (Adaptive control), -AU (Automatic), -MA (Manual), -ME (Mechanized), -RO (Robotic), -SA (Semiautomatic). results.query: Which waveform diagram illustrates upslope and downslope current intervals for pulsed welding cycles?
results.answer: In Figure B53 (An Example of a Welding Cycle for Pulsed Welding, printed p. 157), the diagram illustrates an example of a welding cycle for pulsed welding. Its parameter traces plotted against time include: WELDING CURRENT, ARC VOLTAGE, WIRE FEED SPEED, TRAVEL SPEED, SHIELDING GAS FLOW. The upslope and downslope current intervals define transition timing: UPSLOPE TIME transitions current up to WELD TIME (comprising HIGH PULSE TIME and LOW PULSE TIME), while DOWNSLOPE TIME transitions current down toward crater fill and POSTFLOW TIME.

results.query: In resistance spot welding waveforms, what intervals occur during a pulsation welding cycle?
results.answer: In Figure B49 (Example of a Pulsation Welding Waveform for Resistance Spot Welding, printed p. 153), the synchronized vertical traces plotted against the horizontal TIME axis are RESISTANCE WELDING CURRENT and ELECTRODE FORCE. During the resistance spot pulsation welding cycle, the intervals include SQUEEZE TIME, PREHEAT TIME, UPSLOPE TIME, WELD INTERVAL (containing repeating HEAT TIME and COOL TIME cycles), DOWNSLOPE TIME, QUENCH TIME, TEMPER TIME, HOLD TIME, and OFF TIME.

results.query: What is the preferred standard term for the shop-floor term stick electrode, and what process does it relate to?
results.answer: In Clause 4 and Annex C of AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020, 'stick electrode' is a nonstandard shop-floor term printed in lightface type that redirects to the preferred standard term covered electrode. In the context of welding processes, 'stick electrode welding' redirects to the preferred standard term shielded metal arc welding (SMAW).

results.answer: In Clause 4 (printed p. 61) of AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020, undercutting refers to the standard term undercut, defined as: 'A groove melted into the base metal adjacent to the weld toe or weld root and left unfilled by weld metal. results.query: What preheat temperature and Charpy impact toughness are specified for structural steel?
results.answer: The query is outside the scope of AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020 (Standard Welding Terms and Definitions). Mechanical material properties and external boiler code designations are not specified in this terminology standard. Quantitative mechanical properties (tensile and yield values, elongation, Charpy V-notch toughness, hardness) and filler metal chemical composition limits are material specification requirements governed by filler metal and base material standards (e.g., AWS A5 series, ASTM), not terminology definitions.
